profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mailchimp
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer and Systems Engineer.  Lots of Java and PHP development at Salesforce, using Kafka event streams, Oracle database, and REST APIs.

At Cox Communications, I was responsible for a large Sun (Oracle) Solaris dev/engineering environment.

I have experience in networking systems together, including protocol analysis with tools like Wireshark.

I especially enjoy Linux-based development environments.  In my free time, I enjoy building electronic circuits using PIC and ARM microcontrollers, using C and assembly languages.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Development of new features in the "core" Salesforce application, using Java and PHP.  Oracle, PostgreSQL, PL/SQL, and MySQL for database.  Event-based flows using Kafka and internal APIs.  Email marketing automation (Pardot) platform development.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · PHP · Linux · SQL · Java
